title: [P1][Docs] Add repository setup guide
description:
## Goal
Create a concise setup guide for a fresh clone.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] README includes install, dry-run, and execute commands
- [ ] Environment variables are documented in .env.example
- [ ] Sample JSON files validate in dry-run mode

title: [P1][Infra] Add CI for lint and tests
description:
## Goal
Run quality checks on pull requests.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] pytest runs the unit test suite
- [ ] ruff checks formatting-sensitive Python issues
- [ ] CI uses the package's supported Python versions
